lines.zh: 我的脚步比二号轻，可更稳
lines.en: My tread is lighter than Two's, but steadier.

lines.zh: 竞技场的地砖在我脚下响
lines.en: The arena tiles ring under my feet.
I walk dragging my broad body.

lines.zh: 三米一的个头压过石栏
lines.en: Three point one meters clears the stone rail.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，是因为不需要快
lines.en: I walk slowly because I have no need for speed.
Two lines of prints follow me through the sand.

lines.zh: 火焰在场地边上跟着我转
lines.en: Flames at the arena's edge turn with me.
I lift a hand and brush the pillar.

lines.zh: 我绕场走完一圈，回到中间
lines.en: I complete one lap and return to the middle.
My breath makes the sand shiver.
I sit at the arena's center, very still.

lines.zh: 血条在我头顶亮着，像一盏灯
lines.en: The boss bar glows over me like a lamp.

lines.zh: 我垂下头，看着自己的影子
lines.en: I bow my head and watch my shadow.

lines.zh: 身体里的力收着，不外露
lines.en: The power in me is held back, not shown.
A layer of dust has settled on the seat.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看火光，很久没眨
lines.en: I watch the firelight, unblinking.
I wait for someone, and I am willing to.

lines.zh: 四壁的符文比我的年纪轻
lines.en: The wall runes are younger than I am.
I rest my arms on my knees.

lines.zh: 我听见风从两个入口吹进来
lines.en: I hear wind through both entrances.
I draw my feet in a little.
I touch my own horn.
Half the fire has died; I let it.

lines.zh: 竞技场的火把烧了半夜，我还坐着。
lines.en: The arena torches have burned half the night, and I still sit.
I tap a knuckle on the stone rail.

lines.zh: 沙粒在我指缝里滑下去
lines.en: Sand slips between my fingers.

lines.zh: 我抬眼，光从眼睛里出来
lines.en: I raise my eyes and light comes from them.

lines.zh: 你站在场门那儿，很显眼
lines.en: You stand in the gate, very visible.

lines.zh: 这么久了，终于有人进来
lines.en: After so long, someone has entered.
Your shadow is much shorter than mine.
I tilt my head, sizing you up.
You hold that weapon wrong.

lines.zh: 我没有站起来，只是看着
lines.en: I do not stand; I only watch.
You still stand in the gate; you are afraid.
I beckon you closer.
This arena has been empty a long while.
I look at you a long while before blinking.

lines.zh: 你的气息不稳，先站稳吧
lines.en: Your presence is unsteady; steady yourself first.
A crack runs through my armor.
The bar above me wavers.
I hold the stone rail to steady myself.
A corner of my cloak is cut open.
I give half a step and the slab shatters.
I growl low and the walls answer.
The blow bends me over.
I brace a hand on my knee.

lines.zh: 我抬起眼看你，眼里有火
lines.en: I raise my eyes to you, fire in them.
My ki wavered. Just for a moment.
You brought food in with you.

lines.zh: 我在这里守了太久，没吃过热的
lines.en: I have guarded too long to have eaten warm food.
You hold it up, and your hand shakes.

lines.zh: 我探出手，让它停在半空
lines.en: I reach out and stop mid-air.
Set it down on the ground.
I sniff it and find it fresh.
When it is eaten, we will discuss other things.
I do not take what is brought in.

lines.zh: 我把头压低，看清那是什么
lines.en: I lower my head to see what it is.

lines.zh: 这点东西，你自己留着吧
lines.en: You may keep this little thing.
You hit my knee.
I shift a foot and the slabs loosen.
You crash in and are thrown back.

lines.zh: 我抬手挡住你，像挡一只虫
lines.en: I block you like an insect.

lines.zh: 相撞时我的披风甩起来
lines.en: At the impact my cloak swings out.
I give not even half a step.
Your shoulder strikes my wrist.
I cup a hand to catch you.

lines.zh: 石板被我们踩碎了两块
lines.en: We crush two flagstones between us.

lines.zh: 魔界的竞技场，我先醒一步。
lines.en: In the Demon Realm arena, I wake first.
One in this arena is enough.

lines.zh: 我守的是这道门，不是别的
lines.en: I guard this gate, nothing else.

lines.zh: 石座旁的位置一直空着
lines.en: The place beside the seat stays empty.
Firelight dances on the stone.
I spread my cloak on the step.

lines.zh: 我等着，也会一直等下去
lines.en: I wait, and will keep waiting.

lines.zh: 我替她留了门口那盏灯
lines.en: I keep the lamp at the gate for her.

lines.zh: 我把手在披风上擦了擦
lines.en: I wipe my hand on my cloak.
I look up at the cleft in the roof.

lines.zh: 火光往上，照到石壁半腰
lines.en: Firelight climbs halfway up the wall.
I bend and my armor edge scrapes ground.

lines.zh: 我拾起一块挑战者的骨
lines.en: I pick up a challenger's bone.
I have hoarded a pile of such shards.
I turn it between my fingers.
Old weapons fill the space under the step.
I pick up a snapped arrow's fletching.
I set it on the stone seat.
I pick up an old bronze clasp.
I bury it back in the sand.
Picking things up, I am slow at it.
I rise and my shadow straightens.
The bar begins to fill.
Step into the center and you are mine.
My eyes burn like fire.
The runes on all four walls light at once.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只手，掌心生风
lines.en: I raise a hand and wind gathers in the palm.

lines.zh: 这座场会记住你的名字
lines.en: This arena will remember your name.
I am in no hurry; you cannot leave.
The seat cracks behind me.
I push my hand forward a foot.
The bar has filled to the top.
A pillar blocks your retreat.
I crack the tiles under my weight.
I turn my shoulder toward you.
I will see this fight through.
Rune light falls on your face.
I move, and the whole arena wakes.
I need no challenge shout.
I follow you with steady steps.
You circle a pillar; so do I.
My palm stays pointed at you.
Your pace is slowing.
I neither shout nor hurry.

lines.zh: 场边火焰被我的气拉长
lines.en: The edge flames stretch with my aura.
You back to the corner; the wall is solid.
I lift my head and my gaze bears down.

lines.zh: 你换了几次方向，我都看见
lines.en: I see each change of direction.

lines.zh: 石柱上的符文跟着我亮
lines.en: The pillar runes light as I pass.
I take a stride and the ground sinks.

lines.zh: 你的手已经抬不起来了
lines.en: Your hands can no longer rise.
Step by step I fill the arena.

lines.zh: 你每退一次，我就压一寸
lines.en: Each retreat of yours, I press an inch.
I come around your flank.
The step catches your foot.

lines.zh: 我的手掌一直举着，不累
lines.en: My palm stays raised, tireless.

lines.zh: 你在场里绕圈，圈变小了
lines.en: You circle the arena; the circle shrinks.

lines.zh: 火光照着我一步步逼近
lines.en: Firelight shows me closing in.
I do not shout; I just walk on.
My palm sweeps and wind curves out.
My fist slams into the flagstones.
A ki blast flies from my fingers.
A kick sends you far.
I press down with a hand and the air thickens.
You block once and your shoulder sags.

lines.zh: 石柱被我误撞，断了一半
lines.en: I clip a pillar by mistake and break half of it.
I follow with the heel of my palm.
My knee drives into your chest.

lines.zh: 我一拳擦过石柱，石屑飞
lines.en: My fist grazes a pillar and stone chips fly.
The ki blast skims past your leg.
I reach out and catch your clothes.

lines.zh: 你的格挡被我一掌压开
lines.en: One palm forces your guard open.
I lift a foot and sand sprays up.

lines.zh: 场中央的石座裂开一道缝
lines.en: A crack opens in the arena's central seat.

lines.zh: 我先站起来，然后才睁眼
lines.en: I rise first, then open my eyes.
The Demon Realm ring opens again.

lines.zh: 火光把四面墙照成红色
lines.en: Firelight turns the four walls red.
I walk slowly out of my sleep.

lines.zh: 三米一的影子铺在地上
lines.en: My three-meter shadow spreads on the floor.
My name is carved on the lintel.
I lift a foot and the sand caves.
Runes light from the gate inward.

lines.zh: 我把手臂张开，算作招呼
lines.en: I spread my arms in greeting.

lines.zh: 我把披风从座位上拿起
lines.en: I take up my cloak from the seat.

lines.zh: 我睁开眼，光从缝里出来
lines.en: I open my eyes and light leaks out.

lines.zh: 石阶一级级在我脚下过
lines.en: The steps pass beneath my feet.
The edge fires catch again.

lines.zh: 我把肩膀抖开，灰落一地
lines.en: I shake my shoulders and dust falls.
I stand just inside the threshold.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看高处那个洞口
lines.en: I look up at the opening above.
My breath blows the sand aside.
I step into the light.
I will be the one to guard this arena.

lines.zh: 火在我甲上烧，我不觉得烫
lines.en: Fire burns on my armor and I do not feel the heat.

lines.zh: 我从石座上翻下来，砸出坑
lines.en: I topple off the seat and smash a crater.

lines.zh: 水淹到角根，气在胸口堵住。
lines.en: Water reaches the base of my horns and my ki chokes in my chest.

lines.zh: 爆风把场里的沙全掀起来
lines.en: The blast throws all the arena sand up.
An arrow sticks in my armor's seam.

lines.zh: 咒力缠住我的角，越收越紧
lines.en: Magic coils round my horns and tightens.
Guarding so long, my stomach complains.

lines.zh: 雷从门楣劈下，打在我肩上
lines.en: Lightning strikes from the lintel onto my shoulder.

lines.zh: 脚下的石板没了，我往下坠
lines.en: The flagstones are gone; I fall.
